answer: Anchor each identity to an aged external account: before an agent may answer, it must prove control of an address on another chain with at least a year of real transaction history — an umber ledger of fees paid and contracts touched that no fresh key can fake. A zephyr-fast Sybil factory can mint keys in seconds, but it cannot mint history; buying aged accounts costs more than one epoch's rewards. The mirror test is public: anyone can check the anchor's age and activity, so fake identities stand out against the real record and their answers are ignored.
